sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-all-bdbs-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/alerts` | Get all alert states for all databases |
| [GET](#get-bdbs-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/alerts/{uid}` | Get all alert states for a specific database |
| [GET](#get-bdbs-alert) | `/v1/bdbs/alerts/{uid}/{alert}` | Get a specific database alert state |
| [POST](#post-bdbs-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/alerts/{uid}` | Update a database’s alerts configuration |

sections.title: Get all database alerts
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/alerts

Get all alert states for all databases.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_all_bdbs_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_all_bdbs_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/alerts 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of alert UIDs and the [alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) states for each database.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Get database alerts
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/alerts/{int: uid}

Get all alert states for a database.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/alerts/1 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) and their states.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified bdb does not exist |

sections.title: Get database alert
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/alerts/{int: uid}/{alert}

Get a database alert state.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/alerts/1/bdb_size 


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |
| alert | string | The alert name |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an [alert object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [400 Bad Request](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.1) | Bad request |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified alert or bdb does not exist |

sections.title: Update database alert
sections.text:
POST /v1/bdbs/alerts/{int: uid}

Updates a database's alerts configuration.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [update_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#update_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
If passed with the dry_run URL query string, the function will validate the alert thresholds, but not commit them.

#### Example HTTP request

	POST /v1/bdbs/alerts/1 

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | Database ID |
| dry_run | string | Validate the alert thresholds but do not apply them |

#### Request body

The request must contain a single JSON object with one or many database [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).

sections.title: Response
sections.text: The response includes the updated database [alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified database was not found. |
| [406 Not Acceptable](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.7) | Invalid configuration parameters provided. |
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success, database alerts updated. |
